responsibility: Windows Structured Exception Handling support layer for GNAT. It maps native SEH exception codes to predefined Ada exceptions and messages, defines the actual SEH error handler used to convert hardware/software faults into Ada raises, and installs the required handler representation for 32-bit stack-based SEH or 64-bit pdata/unwind-table based handling. This file is the Windows-specific analogue of the POSIX signal-mapping logic in init.c.
